dependency_evidence: evidence/SV2-IDX-01/result.json records the session catalog, archive manifest and grant checks this package reads; the catalog tables, ingest and archive functions are unchanged here
evidence_class: mocked: an in-process caller, a SQLite catalog file and a local content addressed object folder stand in for the session service, the central database and the archive bucket; no embedding model, HTTP server or Pod runs
interfaces: hooks.memory.chunking.chunk_events(policy, scope, source_generation, events) turns committed catalog events into chunk records: a turn starts at each user text event; its narrative events pack whole into turn chunks up to the policy bound; each tool call pairs with its result by tool use id into one tool chunk carrying the turn id and both event ids

A chunk id is a digest of the chunker version, access domain, session uid, source generation, chunk kind and the source event sequences it covers; list position never enters it, so appending events leaves every chunk of earlier complete turns byte identical

Each chunk keeps a preview bounded by the policy character limit, with truncated and omitted_chars, and a content_hash of that preview for embedding reuse; the evidence list and hooks.memory.chunking.locator give the exact archive source ranges, read whole through hooks.memory.archive.source_range
hooks.memory.chunking.ChunkIndex adds chunk_generation, search_chunk and chunk_cutover tables to the catalog database; they are projections and never replace session_event or archive rows

ChunkIndex.build(grant, scope, policy) reads events through the SV2-IDX-01 grant check, stores one generation per chunker version, inserts only new chunk ids, removes chunks a grown open turn superseded, and refuses a changed policy under the same version, a changed stored chunk, or a build that read fewer events than the stored generation, changing nothing

ChunkIndex.validate(store, grant, domain, session_uid, version) reads the whole session evidence through hooks.memory.archive.evidence and checks every chunk range against the catalog before marking the generation validated; a missing archive object or unknown range refuses and leaves the generation built

ChunkIndex.activate(domain, session_uid, version, revision) is compare and set on the cutover revision and accepts only a validated generation; rollback activates the prior validated generation; ChunkIndex.active(grant, domain, session_uid) returns the active generation's chunks under the same grant
docs/swarm-v2/schemas/chunk.json is the chunk record contract

supported_versions.chunker_versions: turn-v1 with a 2000 character bound is the default policy; any other version is a separate generation
supported_versions.storage: SQLite catalog with WAL journal and synchronous FULL from SV2-IDX-01; local folder object store

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran twice from independent temporary folders with identical records.
states.accepted: A build is accepted when it returns committed; a generation when validate returns validated; a cutover when activate returns the next revision.
states.committed: Each build and each cutover commits in one SQLite transaction with the chunk rows, the generation row and the rebuild counter; validation commits its state change in one statement.
states.externally_verified: Not yet: no deployed session service, embedding worker or database ran; a live check belongs to the G4 rollout gate.

metrics.chunks_rebuilt_without_content_change: durable per access domain in ingest_counter: the number of chunks a build inserted under a new id with the same kind, preview hash and evidence as a chunk it removed

rollback_rehearsal.action: Activate the prior validated chunk generation with the current cutover revision; no source record, archive object or other generation is deleted.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The session_event, session_source, archive_manifest rows and archived objects from SV2-IDX-01; chunk rows are derived projections.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: Case C builds turn-v2 beside the active turn-v1, restarts the catalog, replays the build with no effect, refuses a stale build and a stale cutover, cuts over to turn-v2, then restores turn-v1 and compares its chunks and the catalog event ids with those before the cutover.

remaining_limitations: No embedding model runs here; content_hash and the inserted id list are what the SV2-IDX-03 worker uses to embed only new chunks.
Narrative parts pack whole events with no character overlap between parts; neighbouring context comes from the shared turn id and the evidence locator.
A single event longer than the bound is cut at the bound for its preview; the full event stays in the archive.
compatibility: Explicitly local compatibility path: the SV2-IDX-01 catalog tables, ingest, archive evidence and source range reads are unchanged; the chunk tables are additive and a consumer that ignores them sees no change.
authority: Builds and reads take the caller's Grant and pass the SV2-IDX-01 check: the domain must be the grant's corpus, every event's project must be in the grant or unattributed, and the session must be retained. Validation reads evidence under the same grant. A display name never grants access.
